acceptanceCriteria.criterion: A relative configured log path can never write outside the repo (escape falls back to the in-repo default).
No code path can produce a per-run trace filename; one destination remains.
A validated trace CLI + make target writes redacted UTC lines.
Orchestrated runs emit action/decision traces via lifecycle hooks without failing the run.
The three loop CLIs emit a checkpoint trace without changing exit codes.
make test && make check green with regenerated payload.

closure.reason: Warranted applicability derives only from boundary/public_contract/security signals in a single-repo tool. No separate DDD report/graph artifact was produced because the change is contained to scripts/** and csm-orchestrate/lib/** with direct unit coverage; the durable evidence is the landed code and passing tests in commits c4eabb6 and 0d3ccfa (plus the session-lifecycle loop-CLI trace emission).

spikeCandidates.candidate: Confirm a relative configured value that escapes the main root falls back to the in-repo default and never writes outside; sandbox only.
